user.title: NibePi
user.description: Connect to a NibePi gateway over MQTT. The MQTT integration must be set up first.

data_description.prefix: config.mqtt.topic on the gateway, e.g. nibe/modbus/

price.title: Electricity prices
price.description: Where NibePi reads the electricity prices for the price component. Each loaded Tibber integration is listed by name.

data_description.price_source: Tibber: prices from the tibber.get_prices action. Price sensor entity: a Nordpool or similar sensor with the prices in its attributes. None: the price component contributes 0.

tibber_warning.title: Tibber account
tibber_warning.description: You chose the Tibber integration "{chosen}", but the tibber.get_prices action always uses the first Tibber integration, "{first}". Prices will come from "{first}". To use "{chosen}", remove the other Tibber integration or add "{chosen}" first. Submit to continue.

tibber_home.title: Tibber home
tibber_home.description: The Tibber account has several homes. Choose the one whose prices should control the heat pump.

data_description.tibber_home: The home's nickname in the Tibber app. Empty: the first home.

data_description.price_entity: Nordpool (raw_today/raw_tomorrow or today/tomorrow) or Tibber-style attributes (startsAt/total).

system_s1.title: Climate system {system}
system_s1.description: Room sensors and setpoint. Everything else is under Configure after setup.

data.indoor_entity: Indoor temperature sensor, e.g. Netatmo (empty = pump's BT50)
data.rmu_entity: Room temperature for the pump's RMU40 (empty = the indoor sensor)

data_description.indoor_entity: Used by the indoor component, which adjusts the curve offset. Recommended: a room sensor such as Netatmo's indoor module. Staleness is judged by its last report, so an unchanged value is not stale. Left empty, the pump's BT50 room sensor (register 40033/40032) is used.
data_description.rmu_entity: Sent to the pump as the room temperature of a virtual RMU40 when the switch 'Send room temperature to pump (RMU40)' is on (off by default). With the pump's own room sensor correction on, switch the indoor component off, or the correction is applied twice (see the README).

data.price_very_cheap_below: Own threshold: very cheap at or below (öre)
data.price_very_expensive_above: Own threshold: very expensive at or above (öre)
data.weather_forecast_adjust: Shift forecast by measured outdoor temperature

data_description.sensor_timeout: An indoor or outdoor value older than this counts as missing and its component gives 0.
data_description.price_source: Tibber: prices from the tibber.get_prices action. Price sensor entity: a Nordpool or similar sensor with the prices in its attributes. None: the price component contributes 0.
data_description.price_unit_factor: 100 when prices are in SEK/kWh (Tibber, most sensors), 1 when they are in öre/kWh.
data_description.price_very_cheap_below: Set both thresholds to replace the optimiser's level.

tibber_missing.title: Tibber prices are not available
tibber_missing.description: NibePi is set to read electricity prices with the tibber.get_prices action, but the Tibber integration is not set up or not loaded. Set up the Tibber integration, or choose another price source in NibePi's options. Until then the price component contributes 0.
